status: DRAFT v0-draft (track S, 2026-10-07): the review_decision tool for arms 2 and 3, in OpenAI function format; one schema per rewind mode. Argument shapes follow brief-interfaces.md exactly.

function.name: review_decision
function.description: Your one decision for this review: rewind parts of your state, drop units from your context, keep units from undone steps, or change nothing.

rewind.description: null to rewind nothing; otherwise the point (0 = start of the task, k = right after step k) for each part, or null to leave that part as it is.

drop.description: IDs of units to remove from your context (context only, never files).

keep.description: IDs of units from steps the context rewind undoes, to be handed back after the rewind.

change_nothing.description: true to keep everything as it is (then rewind is null and drop and keep are empty).

function.name: review_decision
function.description: Your one decision for this review: rewind everything to one point, drop units from your context, keep units from undone steps, or change nothing.

rewind_to.description: null to rewind nothing; otherwise the point (0 = start of the task, k = right after step k) that the workspace, runtime, context and outputs all return to.

drop.description: IDs of units to remove from your context (context only, never files).

keep.description: IDs of units from steps the rewind undoes, to be handed back after the rewind.

change_nothing.description: true to keep everything as it is (then rewind_to is null and drop and keep are empty).
